verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: aap bhalaa sabh jag bhalaa bhalaa bhalaa sabhanaa kar dhekhai|

en.bdb: One's good mind finds everybody good in the world. A gentleman beholds everyone as gentle.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰੇ ਦੇ ਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: aap buraa sabh jag buraa sabh ko buraa bure dhe lekhai|

en.bdb: If one is bad himself, for him the whole world is bad and all is bad on his account. Lord Krsna helped

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸਨੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਪਾਂਡਵਾਂ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: kisan sahaiee paa(n)ddavaa(n) bhai bhagat karatoot visekhai|

en.bdb: Pindays because they had in them profuse sense of devotion and morality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੈਰ ਭਾਉ ਚਿਤਿ ਕੈਰਵਾਂ ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣਨਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: vair bhaau chit kairavaa(n) ganatee ganan a(n)dhar kaalekhai|

en.bdb: Kaurays had enmity in their heart and they always calculated the dark side of things.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਪਰਵੰਨਿਆ ਭਾਲਣ ਗਏ ਨ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸਰੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhalaa buraa parava(n)niaa bhaalan ge na dhisaT sarekhai|

en.bdb: Two princes went out to find a good and a wicked person but their views were different.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਜੁਧਿਸਟਰੈ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਭੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: buraa naa koiee judhisaTarai dhurajodhan ko bhalaa na bhekhai|

en.bdb: None was bad for Yudhisthar and Duryodhan did not find any good person.
Whatever (sweet or bitter) is there in the pot is known when it comes out through the spout.
